cited_by.title: Skin cancer and moles on dark skin

record.population: Literature on skin cancer in skin of colour
record.finding: In dark-skinned groups squamous cell carcinoma is most common, squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma usually occur on non-sun-exposed sites, and UV is not an important cause except for basal cell carcinoma. Skin cancer is less common but often has greater morbidity and mortality.
